correctness.rationale: For a,e invertible over algebraically closed characteristic 2, all four partial derivatives reduce to e times the coordinate triple products. Their squarefree scheme is six coordinate edges, with no vertices on F=0. Each edge intersects in the square of the explicit binary quadratic a(u^4+v^4)+beta*u^2*v^2, giving exact finite flat degree-four subschemes and support 2+2 or 4. Unit transverse uv-polar term and critical section force completed local equation UV+s^2 or UV+s^4 by formal splitting, hence precisely A1/A3. Isolated singularities imply irreducibility and normality; adjunction gives K3 after ADE resolution. Gauss restricted to torus is standard cubic Cremona, an involution, and substituting into F gives an irreducible homogeneous degree-12 dual equation without coordinate factors. Exact GF4 verifier checks all four zero-wall types and Cremona support; finite checks are corroboration only.
